data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (recepcionista por un día) y varias llamadas.
data.script: Diego: School phone, Diego speaking! … Diego: Call one: the bus driver. The school trip bus will arrive at quarter past nine, not nine. … Diego: Call two: Oliver's mum. He forgot his lunch box — again! … Diego: Call three: wrong number. Somebody wanted a pizza restaurant. … Diego: Call four: the library. Maya's science book has arrived. … Diego: Call five: the vet! Kili's new vitamins are ready. Yes, the call was for Kili! … Diego: And call six… my own grandma, just to say good luck with my report. Thanks, grandma!
